crime_highlights: He was one of five youths who participated in a riot that lasted about six hours
substantial damage (in excess of $150,000) was done to the facility
Mr. G. suffered a traumatic brain injury
rationale_highlights: substance abuse as well as the substance abuse in his immediate family; poverty; family breakdown
note: Appeal court never says Aboriginal factors reduced culpability; custody upheld.

crime_highlights: Annalee Auckland stabbed her common law spouse Melvin Christison four times with a knife
He died from blood loss resulting from a stab wound 16 cm deep
a stab wound seven cm deep that punctured the right carotid artery
rationale_highlights: the sentencing judge recognized that she had experienced a number of unique systemic or background factors as an Aboriginal offender
those circumstances played a part in bringing her before the Court
He also considered Ms. Auckland's Aboriginal background and the gravity of the offence she had committed
note: Court recognizes background but never says it reduced culpability or sentence.

crime_highlights: Approximately 4,200 marihuana plants in various stages of growth were found on the property

The sentencing judge concluded the appellant used licences authorizing the production of a relatively small number of marihuana plants for personal medical use as a veil of legitimacy in order to avoid detection of the larger illegal enterprise with which he was involved
The sentencing judge concluded that the grow operation had the capacity to generate significant revenue
rationale_highlights: It is apparent that the judge considered the information contained in the Gladue report as providing necessary context to determine an appropriate sentence in this case
He is of Aboriginal heritage and Gladue factors apply and have been specifically identified in the Gladue report
The judge understood that he was required to consider the unique historical, systemic and background factors that may have played a part in the appellant's offending conduct
note: Judge found moral culpability high; no stated reduction for Gladue factors.
